rationale: Audited the pin rather than trusting the round-1 edit I authored: all five acceptance criteria hold -- pnpm check:fast passes 435 tests with package.json at 0.0.18, equal to origin/main; pnpm check:version-bump still exits 1 at that equal version and 0 against a lower base; the version-bump workflow diff is comment-only so the merge gate is untouched; the committed AGENTS.md, docs/coord-driver.md, and docs/repo-map.md blobs no longer instruct a per-commit bump; and the parseDotVersion/isStrictlyGreater unit cases remain, with no call against the live checkout left in the suite and check:version-bump still absent from check and check:fast -- the one outstanding item being the separate 0.0.19 merge-preparation commit the workflow will require on the PR branch, which is deliberately not part of this pin.
